articles.summary: Most of the conversation about H.R. 1 has focused on work requirements. But buried in the same law is a set of changes that will hit a different population just as hard - and with far less warning: older adults and people with disabilities who rely on Medicaid, Medicare Savings Programs (MSP), and Low-Income Subsidy to afford their healthcare.
articles.title: The Quiet Eligibility Crisis Coming for Medicare Dual-Eligible Members

articles.summary: A close read of Nebraska's work requirement forms and what its early enforcement approach signals for other states.
articles.title: What Stands Out in Nebraska's Medicaid Work Requirements Paperwork
